_note: Config for build.py. Titles match loosely (case, accents, punctuation ignored).

film_aliases._note: Alternate Gold Derby spelling -> canonical title, when one film shows up under two names.

display_titles._note: Canonical title -> title shown on the page (use the title a film actually goes by, e.g. its foreign-language title).

tmdb_ids._note: Canonical title -> TMDB movie id, to fix or force a match for release dates, streaming and poster.

justwatch_ids._note: Canonical title -> JustWatch id (tm...), when the automatic title search misses or picks the wrong film.

poster_urls._note: Canonical title -> poster image URL, when JustWatch's US poster is the wrong one (e.g. translated title or extra text).

reddit_threads._note: Canonical title -> r/movies official discussion thread URL, so the after-the-movie page opens that thread (in Narwhal) instead of a search.
